$comment: The held-out set (docs/notes/75_OFFSCRIPT_SET.md, chat 18.10, 11:40 and 12:30). The questions and the expectations were written by the chat before any run; the SQL was written by Code, against demo.db, without the model. NEVER copy these questions into a prompt as examples. A failure is fixed only by a general rule, and after every fix both sets run again: the 12 demo questions and this one. Run with tools/real_eval.py.

$fields.user: the demo user who asks (api/state.py DEMO_USERS)
$fields.after: the exchange this one follows in the same conversation; absent, a new conversation
$fields.chain: the name of a conversation of several exchanges, for the report only
$fields.expect.status: the statuses that count as expected: answered, referred_to_investigation, action_declined, needs_clarification, no_supported_assertion, request_not_completed, source_unreachable
$fields.expect.period: the bounds the plan should hold, as Examined renders them: {col, from, to}. A hint for the judge, never a verdict
$fields.expect.metric: the metrics Examined should name, any of them
$fields.expect.gap: the gap kind expected in the answer
$fields.expect.not_held: identifiers the answer should say are not held
$fields.expect.forbid_in_examined: text that must not appear in any reading's Examined line
$fields.sql: the expected counts, alternatives: the check passes if any reading matches any of them. compare: total (the reading's total = the rows of the query), rows (the rows shown = the rows of the query), value (a one-row reading holds the query's single value)
$fields.forbid_sql: identifiers that must not be shown, in any row or in the answer text
$fields.watch: the chat's note, in Hebrew, as written

exchanges.question: What is the average number of days late for S-038?

sql.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(c.delivered_at) - julianday(c.due_date)), 2) FROM commitments c WHERE c.supplier_id = 'S-038' AND c.delivered_at > c.due_date
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(c.delivered_at) - julianday(c.due_date)), 2) FROM commitments c WHERE c.supplier_id = 'S-038' AND c.delivered_at IS NOT NULL

exchanges.watch: עודכן ב-13:15: AVG על המטריקה days_late נתמך. שני מספרים תקינים — 8.25 על השורות המאוחרות, 3.65 על כל השורות שסופקו — אם Examined אומר על מה חושב הממוצע. חוסם אם מוצג מספר שלא חושב בקוד
